title: OZB Brains Trust - Best Price on This Paw Patrol Toy?
body:
*first forum post, hope this is okay?
Our friends have this specific paw patrol lookout tower and my kiddo absolutely loves it, always wants to go to their house to play with it. Can’t buy a cheap knock off one as this is the one they specifically want and it’s rare for them to ask for something specific without alternatives. I’ve been keeping an eye on it for 6 weeks and not found any great deals.
Regular price is $139 either Big W or Target. Was available on Amazon but seems OOS now.
Figured I’d ask the experts here! If you were buying this, how would you get the best price? Discounted gift cards? Cashback offers? Please share your tips as I really don’t want to spend $139 on this thing haha
https://www.target.com.au/p/paw-patrol-my-size-lookout-tower…
